verdict.rationale: Weaviate documents a first-party Query Agent that runs agentic search over Weaviate Cloud collections and answers natural-language questions about your data. That is a built-in agent you can hand query tasks to, but it is scoped to search/Q&A and is Cloud-only. The MCP server only lets external LLMs and IDE assistants connect, so it is not a built-in assistant. Missing for 10: evidence of delegating tasks beyond search/Q&A (e.g., data management or transformation), an in-product assistant UI, self-hosted availability, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: Query Agent: Run agentic search over your Weaviate Cloud collections
Get answers from your data by using a natural language prompt/question. Cloud only
